updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new least-privilege Purview RBAC role enables auditors and security analysts to view device onboarding status without requiring broad administrative permissions like Compliance Administrator or Global Administrator. This granular role-based access control improves security posture by following the principle of least privilege for Endpoint DLP device management.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector exposes sensitive information to unauthorized actors through local access. Admins must apply security patches immediately to prevent potential exposure of identity and access control data.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70240: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A memory leak in Windows Kerberos allows unauthorized attackers to cause denial of service over the network, potentially disrupting authentication services across your organization. This affects core identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: Improper certificate validation in Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass security features over the network. This can undermine PKI-based authentication and encryption across your environment.

updates.title: CVE-2026-95884: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: A buffer over-read vulnerability in Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. Organizations running AD CS should prioritize patching to protect certificate infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Maximum auto-labeling capacity has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to protect more data at rest faster. This enhancement helps close labeling gaps and better prepare data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics and AI-Powered Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics experience helps admins understand why DLP policies trigger and provides detailed insights into policy evaluation, with Copilot-powered recommendations for E5 customers. This accelerates troubleshooting and policy optimization across your organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Per-Policy Auto-Labeling Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view detailed coverage reports for each enforced auto-labeling policy, showing file volumes labeled and unlabeled compared to simulation snapshots. This visibility helps track enforcement progress and identify gaps in policy coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Restrict Access Action for Fabric Semantic Models and Lakehouses
updates.summary: DLP policies can now control access to Fabric semantic models and lakehouses based on detected sensitive information, blocking guest or all users as needed. This extends consistent data security controls to your Fabric analytics environment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Expanded DLP Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies will support browser inline protection for a broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business, allowing detection and protection of sensitive data shared through supported browser activities. This extends data security controls to more SaaS destinations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing admins to apply restrictive actions based on organizational requirements. This closes a gap in file transfer protection for organizations using these legacy protocols.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109455: Microsoft SharePoint Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: A flawed authorization check in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. Admins should apply patches to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109466: Microsoft SharePoint Missing Authorization Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authorization check in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over an adjacent network. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized administrative access.
